STUDI KASUS 5

Automata Inc. produces specially vehicles by contract.

The company operates several
departments, each of builds a praticular vehicle, such as limousine, a truck, a van or an
RV.

When a new vehicle is built, the department places an order with purchasing
department to request specific component.

Automata's purchasing department is
interested in creating database to keep track of orders and to accelerate the process of
delivering materials,

The order received by purchasing department can contain several different items .

An
inventory is maintained that is the most frequently requested item is inventory.

If an
item is not in inventory, it must be ordered from a supplier .

Each item may have several
suppliers.



1. Define entity and relathionships.
2. Draw the ER diagram with Chen diagram.
3. Draw the ER diagram with Crow Foot diagram.
